run_pipeline_pag_sd_img2img: run the StableDiffusionPAGImg2ImgPipeline to generate images from a prompt and input image using perturbed attention guidance
create_pipeline_pag_sd_img2img: create a StableDiffusionPAGImg2ImgPipeline instance with vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, unet, scheduler, and PAGMixin for image-to-image generation
encode_prompt_pipeline: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings with optional negative prompts, LoRA scaling, and clip skip support
prepare_latents_img2img: prepare initial latents from an input image by encoding through VAE, scaling, and adding noise at a given timestep
apply_perturbed_attention_guidance: apply perturbed attention guidance to noise predictions using pag_scale and pag_adaptive_scale for improved image generation quality
